purpose: More short and medium-length candidates with independently verified support for unused revision-28 vocabulary.
method: Each proposal is independently demonstrated with four revision-28 approved partners and at least one unused approved answer. Existing generator and level validation check connectivity, exact letters, no accidental runs, five answers, seven tiles, two long answers, landscape dimensions, density and phone cell size. No production dictionaries or policies changed.
limitations: Independent examples do not establish joint campaign capacity, 75-level spacing or pacing. Ten words are approved for future integration; forty remain unapproved. Active revision 28 and its 2,075-word allowlist are unchanged.
sourceAttribution: Individual dictionary links and hashes identify the Georgian explanatory dictionary by the Linguistic Technologies Group or Georgian Wiktionary. Brief original English glosses only; full definitions are not republished.
